claims.text: Consistency of dialogue agents can be framed as natural language inference (NLI).
Dialogue NLI is a new natural language inference dataset designed for dialogue consistency.
A model trained on Dialogue NLI can be used to improve the consistency of a dialogue model.

evidence.description: Evaluated using human evaluation and automatic metrics on a suite of evaluation sets designed to measure a dialogue model's consistency.

methodologies.name: Dialogue NLI Consistency Enhancement Framework
methodologies.description: Framing dialogue consistency as an NLI task, training models on the Dialogue NLI dataset, and assessing consistency improvements.
conditions: Automatic metrics on dedicated consistency evaluation suite

limitations.text: Consistency is a long standing issue faced by dialogue models.
